blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. JV Ejercito filed on Friday Committee Report No. 131 on the General Appropriations Bill (GAB) for 2027, which incorporated P204.634 billion worth of Senate amendments to strengthen funding for health, education, and critical infrastructure projects. Ejercito, chair of the Committee on Finance, noted that the amendments to the proposed 2027 national budget consisted of P113.286 billion in additional allocations charged against identified funding sources and P91.348 billion in realignments involving existing appropriations with specific funding sources and recipient programs identified.
